seed: Pick several shapes that do not agree about a part and the switch has to say so rather than picking a side. This walk draws three closed paths, gives ONE of them an outline, picks all three and reads the Outline row: it says Mixed, and the line under it counts how many have one. One press makes all three agree, and ONE undo puts all three back the way they were. Then the same question is asked of Fill, so the answer is the row's rule and not one row's special case. (The part this walk asks about has moved twice, because the model under it has: a shadow became an effect you add on 2026-09-07, and the line round a box followed it on 2026-09-08. A box arrives with no edge at all since 2026-09-14, so the two switches a shape really has at birth are the ones asked here, and both of them are reached without opening a menu, which is what keeps this walk running on a locked Mac.)

steps.comment: Three closed paths, each one drawn corner by corner and shut by clicking back on the corner it started from. A closed path is the shape that arrives with BOTH switches this walk is about: a fill that is on and an outline that is not.
The Pen hands the pointer back the moment a path closes, so each new path is armed again.

steps.note: one path with a line round it and two without, so the selection about to be made really does disagree
three picked, one outlined: the Outline row says Mixed beside a switch drawn one step quieter, and the line under it says 1 of the 3 has one
one press: all three have a line, the word is gone and the switch is at full strength
ONE undo puts all three back: only the first path has a line again and the row says Mixed again
the same answer on another part: two of the three still have a fill, so the Fill row says Mixed too
